proposed.title: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer
proposed.text: Freed by the Four, the Surfer takes back his board, revives Sue and flies into Galactus, vanishing in a massive blast. Later, his lifeless body drifts through space until his eyes open and his board returns to him.

changes.evidence: The file ends with the Surfer in custody in Siberia. In the film the Four free him, he regains his board, revives Sue, turns on Galactus and is engulfed in the blast; the mid-credits scene shows him reviving in space.

proposed.title: Inhumans
proposed.text: In episode 8, Auran refuses Maximus's order to kill Medusa, then leaves him and joins the evacuation of Attilan to Earth.

changes.evidence: Episode 8 (...And Finally: Black Bolt): 'Disillusioned, Auran deserts Maximus and joins the evacuation.' Fandom: she refuses his order to kill Medusa and leaves him. Her change of sides has no record; the file ends on Active under Maximus.

now.title: Inhumans
now.text: In episode 4, Locus joins Auran on Earth to hunt down the royal family for Maximus.

proposed.text: In episode 4, Locus joins Auran's squad on Earth to hunt the royal family, until an explosion knocks her out and Black Bolt and Medusa take her prisoner.

changes.evidence: Episode 4 (Make Way for... Medusa): 'Black Bolt escapes with Medusa and Louise, taking an unconscious Locus... with them.' Episode 4 leaves her their prisoner, not At large.

now.title: Inhumans
now.text: A revived, raging Gorgon throws Declan into a Terrigenesis chamber, killing him.

changes.evidence: Declan is handed to Maximus in Attilan (episode 7) and Gorgon throws him into a Terrigenesis chamber there (episode 8); the record has no place.

proposed.title: Cloak & Dagger
proposed.text: In episode 8, haunted by Tyrone posing as Billy's ghost, Connors confesses to the killing and O'Reilly arrests him.

changes.evidence: Season 1 episode 8 (Ghost Stories): Tyrone 'haunts' Connors as Billy's ghost, 'which leads to him confessing to the murder. O'Reilly arrests Connors.' Episode 9 has him suspended, so the episode 10 record still follows.

now.title: Elektra
now.text: Elektra kills him in the hedge maze of her childhood home.
cases: PR-007 The Hunt for the Treasure (Elektra)

proposed.text: Elektra kills him at her childhood home, impaling him with her sai.

changes.evidence: Kirigi is not killed in the hedge maze: Elektra and Abby hide in the maze, where Elektra kills Tattoo, then she faces Kirigi again at the house where he killed her mother and impales him with a sai; he turns to dust as he falls into a pit.
